# API Contract, Sync & Ledger Checklist: Recurring Transactions

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements behind the B7 surface frozen for the C7 client: contract completeness, offline/sync idempotency, concurrency and lock order, time and timezone, money and allocation, authorization.
**Created**: 2026-10-02
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [recurring.yaml](../../../docs/openapi/paths/recurring.yaml) · [ADR-0018](../../../docs/adr/0018-occurrences-materialised-by-the-server.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements. Depth: standard; audience: PR reviewer. The owner delegated the review to the agent running the design phases, which evaluated each item and fixed the spec where an item failed (resolution log below), as for specs 011–013.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## API contract completeness

- [x] CHK001 Is every operation's success status, body and full error-code set specified, including the shared refusals? [Completeness, Spec §5, recurring.yaml]
- [x] CHK002 Is the precedence of refusals specified for rule writes, occurrence writes and materialise? [Clarity, Spec §6]
- [x] CHK003 Are the writable and refused members of each write body enumerated, including server-owned ones (`timezone`, `created_by`, `scheduled_date`, `kind` on an occurrence)? [Completeness, Spec §5, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK004 Is the answer to a write against an occurrence the server never created defined, and consistent with P-06? [Consistency, Spec FR-014, ADR-0018 rule 1]
- [x] CHK005 Are the additive changes to the Transaction resource, the feed row types and the batch type table specified with their versions? [Completeness, Spec FR-023, FR-024]
- [x] CHK006 Are all four C7 "Needs from the backend" answered explicitly (planned status, month-end, occurrence key, series edit)? [Coverage, Spec §5 "Answers C7 needs"]
- [x] CHK007 Is the behaviour of materialise on paused, ended and tombstoned rules defined? [Edge Case, Spec FR-021]
- [x] CHK008 Is it stated that no new error code is introduced, and does each refusal map to an existing catalogue code and pointer? [Consistency, Spec §5]

## Sync and offline idempotency

- [x] CHK009 Is the single generator of occurrences specified, and is the alternative (phone generation) explicitly excluded? [Clarity, Spec FR-009, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK010 Is the occurrence key defined, including the payout case and tombstoned rows? [Completeness, Spec FR-009]
- [x] CHK011 Is the one-transaction-per-occurrence guarantee specified for every path (member confirm, auto-confirm, retries, batch)? [Coverage, Spec FR-015, FR-016, FR-019]
- [x] CHK012 Is the client's required behaviour on a confirm conflict specified (drop the local transaction, never resend under a new id)? [Clarity, recurring.yaml saveOccurrence]
- [x] CHK013 Are rule and occurrence writes made by the server required to stamp the wallet counter like any write? [Consistency, Spec FR-023]
- [x] CHK014 Are tombstone retention exceptions (rule with occurrences, occurrence with a transaction) specified? [Completeness, Spec FR-025]
- [x] CHK015 Is the interaction between a rule edit and a member's offline occurrence edit specified? [Coverage, Edge Cases — fixed]

## Concurrency and lock order

- [x] CHK016 Is one lock order specified for rule writes, occurrence writes, materialise and the job, and is it consistent with ADR-0014 rule 10 and spec 013? [Consistency, Spec FR-026]
- [x] CHK017 Is it specified that the transaction service runs inside the same unit of work as the occurrence's confirmation? [Clarity, Spec FR-016, research R-6]
- [x] CHK018 Is per-rule isolation of the job's units of work specified? [Completeness, Spec FR-020]
- [x] CHK019 Are bounds on the work one unit of work may do specified (materialise cap, auto-confirm cap)? [Measurability, Spec FR-011, FR-017 — fixed]

## Time and timezone

- [x] CHK020 Is "today" defined for a rule, and is its source timezone (including a missing profile) specified? [Clarity, Spec FR-002, FR-011 — fixed]
- [x] CHK021 Is the month-end and leap-day rule specified, with "from the origin" stated? [Clarity, Spec FR-010, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK022 Are weekly, daily and yearly anchors defined unambiguously? [Completeness, Spec FR-010, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK023 Is the auto-confirm start defined for creation, resume and switching `auto_confirm` on? [Completeness, Spec FR-017]
- [x] CHK024 Are "due" and "missed" defined, and is it stated they are not stored? [Clarity, Spec FR-013]
- [x] CHK025 Is the hourly cadence tied to a measurable posting delay? [Measurability, Spec SC-004]

## Money and allocation

- [x] CHK026 Is the split of a total specified (even shares, remainder to the earliest rounds) and required to sum exactly? [Clarity, Spec FR-012, SC-006]
- [x] CHK027 Is a total smaller than the number of rounds addressed? [Edge Case — fixed, Spec FR-004]
- [x] CHK028 Is the gam'eya payout amount defined, including skipped rounds and occurrence edits, with an upper bound? [Clarity, Spec FR-012]
- [x] CHK029 Is changing `occurrence_count` after a resolution prevented where it would re-spread shares or the payout? [Consistency — fixed, Spec FR-007]
- [x] CHK030 Is it stated that a scheduled occurrence never posts and never enters a balance? [Clarity, Spec FR-013, P-05]

## Authorization

- [x] CHK031 Are matrix rows referenced (not restated) for every read and write, including materialise and edit-one? [Consistency, Spec §6, spec 010 R-02]
- [x] CHK032 Is the destination requirement for a transfer rule specified for writes and for confirmations? [Completeness, Spec FR-029]
- [x] CHK033 Is the authority under which automatic confirmation acts specified, with the outcome when the author lost it? [Coverage, Spec FR-017, FR-018, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK034 Is category ownership specified for occurrence edits and for confirmations made by a member other than the author? [Clarity — fixed, Spec FR-014, FR-016]
- [x] CHK035 Is the not-found discipline specified for a transfer rule read through its destination wallet? [Coverage, Spec §6]
- [x] CHK036 Is it specified whether a refused automatic confirmation is ever retried, and what re-enables it? [Clarity — fixed, Spec FR-018]

### Resolution log

| Item | Gap found | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| CHK015 | A rule edit propagating into a pending occurrence while a member edited it offline was unspecified | Edge Cases: the member's save is a version conflict carrying the updated occurrence; `edited` occurrences are never touched |
| CHK019 | The auto-confirm pass had no bound (a rule resumed after a long backlog could confirm hundreds in one unit of work) | FR-017: oldest first, at most 50 per rule per pass |
| CHK020 | No timezone when the author has no profile row | FR-002: the configured default timezone (Identity's existing fallback) |
| CHK027 | A total of 5 minor units over 12 rounds would produce zero-amount occurrences | FR-004: `amount_minor ≥ occurrence_count` for `total`, else `OUT_OF_RANGE` |
| CHK029 | Editing `occurrence_count` after a resolution re-spread a total's shares and changed a gam'eya payout; a count below `payout_round` was undefined | FR-007: count frozen for gam'eya and `total` rules after the first resolution; count below payout round `OUT_OF_RANGE` |
| CHK034 | Category rules for an edited occurrence (kind, ownership, transfer) were only implied | FR-014: kind, liveness and own-or-platform-unless-unchanged; transfer stays null |
| CHK036 | "A manual save clears the refusal" did not say whether automatic confirmation resumes or whether an identical save counts | FR-018: a changing save clears it and re-enables it; an identical save changes nothing |

All fixes are mirrored in `recurring.yaml`, `data-model.md` and the plan's Assumed defaults (A-37 to A-39).
